initial_method: Microsoft.VisualBasic SendToRecycleBin called from noninteractive SSH; Windows used permanent-delete fallback
remediation_method: Desktop InteractiveToken, require Environment.UserInteractive=true, verify matching Recycle Bin $I original path and existing $R payload
historical_windows_cleanup_note: Earlier SSH SendToRecycleBin reports only proved source absence. Their recycle-bin claim is not verified and must not be treated as proof of recoverability.
